description: North-Western Province - Names Mr. K. P. K. Kularathna to assist the Commissioner and Registrar of Co-operative Development
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel changes, specifically naming individuals (Kadawatha Pedige Karunasiri Kularathna, Lansakara Mudiyaselage Ananda Ashoka Kumara, and Singhala Pathiranage Rejinold Chandrasena) with their basic appointment titles to assist the Commissioner and Registrar. It does not include detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or subject matter duties, which would make it a Hybrid (Type 3). The content focuses solely on appointments without structural/administrative changes, making it a People Gazette.
